summary: Verstappen hunts sprint pole advantage against a Russell-led Mercedes assault, though the Red Bull ace's settings struggles hint at vulnerability under Singapore's punishing street-circuit demands. Ferrari's Leclerc lurks as a genuine threat in the heat-hazard conditions, with Charles poised to exploit any Mercedes or Red Bull miscue on the narrow, unforgiving Marina Bay layout. A commanding performance here could prove decisive for the championship fight, offering the winner crucial momentum heading into the season's final stretch with only this sprint event and the traditional races remaining.
